title: Lump's War Horn
summary: Blow the horn in Act One to summon Lump, Chock and Fank as neutral combatants.

fields.Availability: Works in the Underdark and when returning to Act One. Does not work on the Rosymorn Monastery Trail.
fields.Combat: The ogres can attack nearby neutral creatures. If no other creatures are available they can turn on the party. Ally-only effects cannot target these neutral combatants.
fields.Bargain: Hire the ogres in Blighted Village. A new or better incentive must be accepted after a fight to summon them again. If you leave Act One in arrears they can arrive to collect. The bargain allows up to three summons. Blowing a pickpocketed horn starts combat with the ogres.
fields.Base value: 25 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
